memory_update.text: AMKR should remain in the reference lane as an AI advanced-packaging and OSAT capacity anchor; promote only if filings or earnings disclose material AI accelerator, HBM-integrated package, customer commitment, utilization, or margin evidence.
AMKR evidence gap: verify whether advanced-packaging capacity is filled by AI accelerator/HBM work versus broader mobile, automotive, communications, or legacy semiconductor packaging demand.

MU should be used primarily as a demand-signal anchor for the HBM supplier chain rather than as the Serenity underfollowed candidate; monitor Micron HBM ramps to infer pressure on probe-card, metrology, inspection, bonding, and test nodes.
MU evidence gap: connect Micron HBM capex and shipment ramps to specific public suppliers in test, probe cards, inspection, metrology, bonding, substrates, and advanced-packaging consumables.

ENB is a speculative-shadow/reference relationship to AI through power and fuel delivery; retain only as a second-order infrastructure hypothesis until direct data-center load, contract, project, or regional pipeline evidence is found.

ENB evidence gap: look for direct mentions of data centers, AI load growth, utility generation demand, pipeline expansions near AI campuses, long-term contracts, and regulatory approvals tied to incremental power demand.

summary: Layer 2B maps the candidate chunk as mostly reference-lane tickers rather than the primary underfollowed alpha lane. Micron is the HBM demand anchor that validates downstream needs for probe cards, metrology, bonding, inspection, and known-good-die testing. Amkor is an OSAT and advanced-packaging capacity anchor, relevant to AI accelerator package assembly and US-based advanced packaging, but the direct AI/HBM package mix and margin quality still require primary-source validation. Enbridge is a second-order energy-delivery hypothesis: AI data-center power demand may increase natural-gas and pipeline infrastructure relevance, but the relationship is indirect and needs project-level evidence before it can survive later Serenity layers.
